title: EventBus registry mutation during emit contract

contract.emit_snapshot: Each emit operates on a snapshot of the listener registry taken before delivery
contract.current_emit_isolation: A listener registered during an active emit is not invoked by that same emit
contract.subsequent_delivery: A listener registered during one emit participates in subsequent emits
contract.ordering: Existing listeners retain registration order and newly registered listeners are appended
contract.registry_stability: Registry mutation during delivery does not corrupt or duplicate existing listeners
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after emits
contract.mutation_safety: Listener registry changes during delivery do not alter the current delivery iteration
